title: New Foundations
start: Portal outside the throne room in the Varrock Palace.

items.t: 352 limestone bricks to make stone wall segments
96 regular planks to make wooden frames

recommended.t: Skull sceptre for quick access to Barbarian Village
Archaeology teleport or Archaeology journal to Infernal Source Dig Site
Earth altar teleport for quick access to Fort Forinthry via the earth altar
Combat gear to defeat several armoured zombies
Activated Varrock lodestone unlocked for quick access to the Blue Moon Inn
Amulet of glory or activated Draynor lodestone to teleport to the Draynor Village market

rewards.t: Access to Fort Forinthry and its facilities
Titles: TitleAnchor | Duke (title) , TitleAnchor | Duchess , and TitleAnchor | Dux

steps.t: Enter the New Foundations portal outside King Roald's throne room in Varrock Palace. [Chat: 1 Yes]
p: King Roald and Queen Ellamaria are talking to a veteran adventurer.

steps.t: After the conversation has ended, enter through the door and talk to King Roald. [Chat: Accept]
After the cutscene, talk with King Roald. [Chat: 2 Sign me up!]
Travel north-east from Varrock, near Jolly Boar Inn and the easternmost boundary of the Wilderness wall.

sub.t: Fastest way to get there is by teleporting to the Infernal Source Dig Site and run slightly north-east (need level 20 Archaeology).
Alternatively, just use Archaeology journal and then head north.

steps.t: Click the portal to "Continue New Foundations". [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Defeat the armoured zombies.
Talk to Bill towards the north of the well.
When the chat has ended, go southwest to the Fort Forinthry blueprints (table behind the bank chest) to build the Workshop.
Check the plans with the Fort Forinthry blueprints and start building the Workshop (Tier 1) which requires:

sub.t: 6 stone wall segments (can be made from 24 limestone bricks)
8 wooden frames (can be made from 96 planks)

steps.t: Build the Workshop by interacting with one of the six Construction hotspots around the edges of the Workshop area.

sub.t: The optimal Construction hotspot moves periodically but improves the progress slightly.

steps.t: Talk to Bill next to the blueprints table.
Head to the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock and talk to Aster (outside by the tables).
p: Aster appears outside the Blue Moon Inn.
Father Flint appears in Draynor Village market.

steps.t: Head to Gunnarsgrunn (Barbarian Village) and talk to Overseer Siv (centre of the village).
Head to Draynor Village and speak to Father Flint in the Draynor Village marketplace.
Head back to the fort and speak to Bill.
Proceed to build the fortifications around the fort. The order does not matter.
Find the appropriate hotspot located within the area.
Front gate
